notes.title: Permanent reduced price and Demo improved visibility !
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
Because it's my first commercial game ever, I made mistakes and I learned form them.

[list]
[*] First mistake was to overprice the game, that's why, starting today, [b]Monster Logic will be permanently half its previous price ($5 in usd for example).[/b]
[*] Second one was to not use the steamworks tools correctly, so [b]now the Free Demo is clearly visible on the store page ![/b] (and not hidden on the right bar)
[/list]

Thanks to all those that supported me and bought the game at full price, your support is incredibly valuable ! If you want to help more, feel free to leave a review, that'd be awesome !

For those who are discovering the game, be sure to test the Demo ! It gives you a good taste of what's in the full game !

notes.title: Monster Logic DEMO available now !
notes.notes:
Come and test the first few levels of Monster Logic for free in this demo!

All features from the main game are available, including Windows and Linux support and 6 different languages!

notes.title: Sneak peek on the artist's work !
notes.notes:
Hi everyone !

I figured it would be interesting to share the first few sketches and the thought process of my wonderful artist, so be sure to check her work on the game at [url=https://www.artstation.com/artwork/6adq4W]this url (artstation)[/url]

I hope you'll like her unique art and the amazing work she did on the game !

notes.title: Monster Logic is releasing the 6th of July !
notes.notes:
Finally, after almost 4 years of dev and beta-testing, the game is ready to release !

[u][b]Monster Logic will release the  6th of July, 2020 ![/b][/u]


The game will feature 42 levels and 5 languages (English, French, German, Chinese and Japanese), and will be available on Windows and Linux !

Thanks for all the people that helped this project comes to life, and I hope the game will please a lot of you !

CvxFous

notes.title: Monster Logic's store page is up ! New Release Trailer!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to share to you that the game I've been working on is almost done, with a beautiful [b]new trailer available[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34513730/4d1031eaa79a71677edfe67a3b18f6cdadd4fed9.png[/img]

Summary of what Monster Logic is:

[quote]Monster Logic is an Indie 2D puzzle/programming game made with passion by one developer. It is loosely based on esoteric programming language Befunge. Using monsters each with unique abilities, the player will have to organize, edit and combine them to provide the correct output for each puzzle.[/quote]


The game is currently on [b]Closed Beta[/b] to try to find and fix the remaining few bugs. Once it's done, I'll have a definitive date to share to all of you here.

Cheers,

Blorp Company
